cover.house: A board and batten gable sits over the front porch of this East End bungalow, with Hardi Plank siding on the walls, a new roof overhead and a new driveway along the side. Inside, one wood-look floor runs from the Living Room through the Dining Area to the Kitchen, and the Primary Bedroom sits at the back under a vaulted ceiling. The wiring, breaker box and plumbing are new, and the house has three-phase power.

photos.title: Living Room
photos.body: A tall window faces the street, and a clerestory window high on the wall adds light above eye level. A wide cased opening on the far side leads to the Dining Area and the Kitchen, and the same wood-look floor runs through all three.

photos.title: Front Entry
photos.body: The wood front door has a window at its top and opens from the covered porch. Past it, the wood-look floor runs back to the Kitchen without a threshold.

photos.title: Kitchen
photos.body: An L-shaped layout with a peninsula, white shaker-style upper cabinets, dark navy lower cabinets and marble-look counters and backsplash. The stainless steel range, sink and dishwasher sit along the L, and the pantry, 4'7" x 3'4", is around the corner.

photos.title: Breakfast Bar
photos.body: Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula that divides the Kitchen from the Dining Area, a step from the range.

right.title: The Primary suite and two more bedrooms

colA.title: Primary Bedroom
colA.body: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam rises over the room, with windows on two walls. The double-door closet is on one wall and a doorway leads to the bath, at the back of the house away from the street.

colA.title: Primary Bath
colA.body: Double sinks sit on a dark navy vanity under an LED backlit mirror. The walk-in shower is tiled in marble-look tile, with a glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld.

colA.title: Primary Closet
colA.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides and shelves above. The shelving stays with the house.

colB.title: Bedroom 2
colB.body: The larger secondary bedroom sits in a front corner, with a window on each outside wall and a ceiling fan overhead. The door opens to the hall, next to Bedroom 3 and a few steps from the hall bath.

colB.title: Bedroom 3
colB.body: The closet is on the hall side, so the window wall stays open for a desk or a dresser. A ceiling fan hangs overhead, and the hall bath is a few steps away.

colB.title: Hall Bath
colB.body: A tub with full-height marble-look tile, a pebble tile niche and a window above it, shared by Bedrooms 2 and 3.

back.title: From the Breakfast Nook to the yard

meals.title: Dining Area
meals.body: The Dining Area sits between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms, with a sputnik-style fixture overhead. The Living Room is a step toward the front and the Kitchen a step toward the back.

meals.title: Breakfast Nook
meals.body: Windows on two walls light the nook, which sits at the back of the house beside the Kitchen. A door opens out to the backyard deck, and the pantry is a few steps away.

outdoor.title: Open Patio and Covered Garage
outdoor.body: At the back of the lot, behind the house, an open concrete patio sits beside the covered garage, and a fence surrounds the whole yard. The garage is the covered space, and the patio is open to the sky.

outdoor.title: The Community Park
outdoor.body: A central park with a brick walk, clipped hedges and young trees, and a tile-roofed gazebo, inside the community. Shrubs line the brick walk and the lawn.

desc: A freestanding Mediterranean-style townhouse stacked across four floors, with stucco walls, a gated courtyard entry, a balcony facing the street and an attached 2-car garage.
Hardwood floors run through the whole home, and the Living Room, Kitchen and Dining area share the open second floor.
The primary suite is on the third floor, a private rooftop patio with wide-angle views of downtown Houston is above that floor, and the community has a central park and guest parking spaces.

living.title: Living Room
sentences: Tall windows and French doors fill the far wall over hardwood floors.
A ceiling fan hangs overhead, and a stair with a black metal railing rises beside the room.
The Living Room, on the second floor, opens to the Kitchen and the Dining area.

entry.title: Staircase
sentences: Wood treads and a handrail run straight up from the hardwood hall, past a white door at the landing.
Hardwood covers the whole home.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
sentences: A center island with a breakfast bar sits under pendant lights, with dark cabinets and a stainless steel refrigerator beside it.
Soft-closing cabinets and drawers have under-cabinet lighting, and hardwood floors run underfoot on the second floor.

bar.title: Kitchen, Dry Bar Side
sentences: A dry bar with its own built-in wine cooler opens right off the Kitchen.
The living space opens wide beyond it to French doors at the far end.

primary.title: Primary Bedroom
sentences: Tall arched windows fill the room, with a ceiling fan over the hardwood floors.
The Walk-in Closet and the Primary Bath open directly off it, on the third floor.
It is the largest bedroom in the whole home.

bath.title: Primary Bath
sentences: A soaking tub sits beside a separate glass shower, with a window next to the shower.
A long dark vanity runs under a wide mirror over tile floors, off the Primary Bedroom on the third floor.

closet.title: Primary Closet
sentences: Custom built-ins fill the walk-in closet, with open shelves, hanging rods and a row of hooks by the door.
A long white ledge runs along one side wall, and the closet opens straight off the Primary Bedroom.

bed.title: Bedroom
sentences: On the first floor, two arched windows light the room over hardwood floors, beside a full bath.
It stands apart from the second-floor living area as the only first-floor bedroom, with the Entry beside it.

bed3.title: Third-Floor Bedroom
sentences: A window with blinds lights the room over hardwood floors, with a door to a bath beside it.
It is one of two upstairs bedrooms, on the third floor near the Primary Bedroom, with a bath separate from the Primary Bath.

laundry.title: Laundry Room
sentences: A white top-loading washer and a front-loading dryer stand side by side on the hardwood floor.
The Utility Room is inside the house, with plain white walls all around.

roof.title: Roof Deck
sentences: A door from the stair opens to the private rooftop patio, a concrete deck with a low parapet wall around it.
The Roof Deck tops the house on the fourth floor, above the Primary Bedroom, with wide-angle views of downtown Houston.
Neighboring roofs lie below the wall.

skyline.title: The Skyline View
sentences: A low white wall frames wide-angle views across the rooftops to the downtown Houston skyline.
A pergola stands on the next roof over, and power lines run overhead.
The view looks out from the very top of the house, four floors up.

dusk.title: Downtown at Dusk
sentences: The towers of downtown Houston stand against an orange sky, seen over the low wall of the roof deck.
The glow fades to a dark band at the horizon above the neighboring rooftops, with lights along the roofline below.
A dark wall fills the foreground.

park.title: The Community Park
sentences: A central park inside the community holds a brick walk, clipped hedges and young trees.
A tile-roofed gazebo stands among the shrubs along the walk and the lawn.
